name: Subject One
source:
Bite-sized static visual novel about becoming something more than human through experimentation. Self-loathing and transformation. Adorn yourself in its fabric.

[From [url=https://eerieemi.itch.io/subjectone]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一口大小的静态视觉小说，讲述通过实验成为超越人类的事物。自我厌恶和转变。用它的面料装饰自己。

[来自[url=https://eerieemi.itch.io/subjectone]itch.io[/url]]
